verse.unicode: ਪਾਨੀ ਪਖਾ ਪੀਸਉ ਸੰਤ ਆਗੈ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਈ ॥

transliteration.english: paanee pakhaa peesau sa(n)t aagai gun govi(n)dh jas gaiee ||

en.bdb: I carry the water, wave the fan, and grind the corn for the Saints; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

verse.unicode: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਮਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੈ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥

transliteration.english: saas saas man naam sam(h)aarai ih bisraam nidh paiee ||1||

en.bdb: With each and every breath, my mind remembers the Naam, the Name of the Lord; in this way, it finds the treasure of peace. ||1||
Have pity on me, O my Lord and Master.

verse.unicode: ਐਸੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

transliteration.english: aaisee mat dheejai mere Thaakur sadhaa sadhaa tudh dhiaaiee ||1|| rahaau ||

en.bdb: Bless me with such understanding, O my Lord and Master, that I may forever and ever meditate on You. ||1||Pause||

verse.unicode: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਛੂਟੈ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਭਰਮਾਈ ॥

transliteration.english: tum(h)ree kirapaa te moh maan chhooTai binas jai bharamaiee ||

en.bdb: By Your Grace, emotional attachment and egotism are eradicated, and doubt is dispelled.

verse.unicode: ਅਨਦ ਰੂਪੁ ਰਵਿਓ ਸਭ ਮਧੇ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥

transliteration.english: anadh roop ravio sabh madhe jat kat pekhau jaiee ||2||

en.bdb: The Lord, the embodiment of bliss, is pervading and permeating in all; wherever I go, there I see Him. ||2||

verse.unicode: ਤੁਮੑ ਦਇਆਲ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥

transliteration.english: tum(h) dhiaal kirapaal kirapaa nidh patit paavan gosaiee ||

en.bdb: You are kind and compassionate, the treasure of mercy, the Purifier of sinners, Lord of the world.

verse.unicode: ਕੋਟਿ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਰਾਜ ਪਾਏ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਨਿਮਖ ਬੁਲਾਈ ॥੩॥

transliteration.english: koT sookh aana(n)dh raaj paae mukh te nimakh bulaiee ||3||

en.bdb: I obtain millions of joys, comforts and kingdoms, if You inspire me to chant Your Name with my mouth, even for an instant. ||3||

verse.unicode: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ॥

transliteration.english: jaap taap bhagat saa pooree jo prabh kai man bhaiee ||

en.bdb: That alone is perfect (chanting, meditation, penance, and devotional worship service) which is pleasing to God's Mind.

verse.unicode: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਭ ਬੁਝੀ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੦॥

transliteration.english: naam japat tirasanaa sabh bujhee hai naanak tirapat aghaiee ||4||10||

en.bdb: Chanting the Naam, all thirst and desire is satisfied; Nanak is satisfied and fulfilled. ||4||10||
